title: The Believer's House
summary: The pipe-keeper's log says the prisoners were moved through a believer house (Cult of Azazel). Find it and talk to the Preacher who lives there. Zealots will come for him once he's talked: kill them, then read the ledger in the house's barrel to learn where Ashford's men are now.

goals.say: The Preacher points at the road. 'They're coming. They know I talked.'
goals.name: The Preacher

goals.say: The last zealot drops a key on a gold chain.

goals.name: Ledger of Ashford

quest_book.title: Ledger of Ashford
quest_book.author: A Believer
pages: Ashford men: 14. Held at the BASTILLE until the portal is ready.
Then through the Nether to the Quarries. Stock for the Quarries. The Chariot wants gold, and gold wants hands.

goals.say: Fourteen men, held in a Bastille.

threats.name: The Preacher
threats.target_line: You're not one of the faithful. ...You're the one from Ashford.
talk: Gone. They stayed one night, chained in my cellar. I prayed over them. That's all I did.
The Bastille. The ledger is in the barrel. Take it. I won't stop you.
Because they cried at night, and my god never answered them. Maybe you will.
